privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Strumok is used only to split the co-op's shared electricity bill between households.

collected.title: What we collect
collected.body: Your name and email, the meter readings you submit, and the charges and payments worked out from them. Monthly consumption can show when a plot is in use, so we treat it as personal data. We use it for co-op billing and nothing else.

access.title: Who can see it
access.body: You see your own households. The head of the co-op and the administrators see everyone's data, because they reconcile the shared bill. It is not shared with anyone else or used for advertising.

hosting.title: Where it is kept
hosting.body: The app runs on FastAPI Cloud and the database is hosted on Supabase. Encrypted backups are stored with Backblaze. Email goes through Brevo and reminders through your browser's push service.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: Billing records are kept for as long as the co-op needs its accounts. Encrypted backups are deleted after about 90 days.

rights.title: Correction, export and deletion
rights.body: To correct your data, get a copy of it or have it deleted, contact the head of the co-op. Requests are handled by hand. Deleting an account anonymizes you but keeps the billing lines, because the co-op's charges and payments must stay on record.
